answer: Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 22 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. Because the nadir cliff is fixed at deposit and recorded in the plume ledger, the garden audit shows how much each key had accrued when it was cut. That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. A farm of 169 pays that 75 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
